title: Japan travel photo caption dataset - record v1
description: One line of metadata.jsonl, describing one shipped image. Captions and category are generated by a local vision-language model and are not checked by a human unless verification.human_verified is true. Location (municipality level) and capture timing (year-month) are derived mechanically from the photo's GPS position and capture date; no coordinates, exact dates or times are included. Caption style rules (sentence count, length, no proper nouns) are checked by tools/validate_records.py, not by this schema.

id.description: Opaque record ID assigned at packaging: a short lowercase prefix and a 6-digit serial number. It is not derived from the original file name or the capture date.

file_name.description: Path of the image file relative to the directory containing metadata.jsonl (Hugging Face ImageFolder convention). Always "images/" + id + ".jpg".

image_info.description: Properties of the shipped image file. EXIF, XMP, IPTC, GPS and comment metadata are removed from shipped files (orientation is applied to the pixels first); only an sRGB ICC profile may remain.

width.description: Width of the shipped file in pixels.

height.description: Height of the shipped file in pixels.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the shipped file's bytes, lowercase hex.

captions.description: AI-generated captions. The generating prompt instructs the model to describe only what is visible, to use no proper nouns (place, facility, brand or train names) and not to describe people; this is not guaranteed (see the error rates in the datasheet).

ja_short.description: Short Japanese caption: one sentence in plain form ending with "。", 15-60 characters, stating the main subject and its situation.

ja_detailed.description: Detailed Japanese caption: 3-5 sentences in plain form, each ending with "。", 80-300 characters in total; covers composition, season and time-of-day cues (only when visible), light, colors and atmosphere.

en_short.description: English rendering of ja_short with the same content: one sentence ending with ".", 5-30 words.

category.description: Category of the main subject. landscape: natural scenery such as mountains, sea, rivers, lakes, fields or sky (wide shots); cityscape: streets, alleys, townscapes, town night views, several buildings together; architecture: one building or structure dominates (temple, shrine, castle, bridge, tower, house); railway: trains, stations or tracks as the main subject; transport: non-rail vehicles and vessels (boats, ferries, buses, planes, ropeways); food: dishes, ingredients, drinks, sweets; flora: flowers, trees or autumn leaves as a close or medium subject; interior: indoor spaces (inn rooms, shops) where the space itself is the subject; other: none of the above. Tie-breaks: a prominent train is railway even in a landscape; food on a table indoors is food; a single shrine gate among trees is architecture; a wide view of autumn mountains is landscape.

location.description: Where the photo was taken, rounded to the municipality (city, ward, town or village); never finer. Determined offline from the photo's GPS position and administrative boundary data, not by AI. null when no Japanese municipality could be determined from GPS (no GPS position, or a position outside Japan's administrative boundaries, e.g. abroad or at sea).

prefecture_en.description: Prefecture name in English (romanized, without suffix), from a fixed 47-entry table.

municipality.description: Municipality name in Japanese (city, town, village or Tokyo special ward; for ordinance-designated cities the ward is included, e.g. "横浜市中区").

municipality_code.description: 5-digit Japanese local government code (全国地方公共団体コード without the check digit), as in attribute N03_007 of the MLIT National Land Numerical Information administrative area data. The first two digits are the JIS X 0401 prefecture code.

capture.description: When the photo was taken, rounded to year and month, from the photo's capture date. null when the photo had no capture date.

season.description: Meteorological season of the capture month by the Japan Meteorological Agency convention (spring: Mar-May, summer: Jun-Aug, autumn: Sep-Nov, winter: Dec-Feb). null when location is null, because the hemisphere is unknown. Derived from the date, not from the image.

provenance.description: How the captions and category were produced.

caption_source.description: Captions are generated by a vision-language model running locally.

caption_model.description: Name and tag of the local vision-language model that generated the captions.

category_source.description: model: category chosen by the vision-language model; rule: category set or corrected by a deterministic rule.

verification.description: Human verification. A random sample of rows is judged by the photographer; all other rows are unverified. Verified rows keep their captions as generated (they are not hand-corrected), so judgment tells whether the shipped captions were found correct.

human_verified.description: true if a human checked this row against the image.

judgment.description: The worst judgment over ja_short, ja_detailed, en_short and category. correct: everything stated is true of the image; minor_error: main subject and category are right but a secondary detail is wrong or the wording is awkward; major_error: main subject misidentified, something prominent described that is not there, wrong category, contradicting season or time of day, a proper noun, a person described, or en_short materially differs from ja_short. null when not verified.

error_fields.description: Fields judged to contain an error. Empty unless judgment is minor_error or major_error.
